claims.statement: For the specified five-element unlabeled Fourier spectral fiber in U(30), two individual labeled character probes isolate the fixed T_C, while three are needed for universal identification.
claims.universe: five three-element subsets of U(30) with Fourier multiset (3,3,1,1,1,1,-1,-1)
claims.probe_model: one labeled Fourier character coefficient per probe

history.event: Earlier internal note records the five-element fiber and targeted two-character isolation; no priority asserted.
Review script enumerates all 56 triples and all character-probe pairs/triples; three global, two targeted.
GitHub Actions RECOH finite character checks passed (run 38528397254); CI does not establish novelty.

exclusions: No theorem for all subsets of arbitrary groups
No proof of analytic estimates or conjectures

claims.statement: For the 21-element Fourier spectral fiber in U(24), two labeled character probes isolate any specified triple; six of the seven nontrivial characters are required for universal identification.
claims.universe: 21 three-element supports {1,a,b} of U(24) isomorphic to C2^3
claims.probe_model: one labeled Fourier character coefficient per probe

history.event: Internal note records the 21-member fiber but not the later universal budget calculation.
Direct Fourier argument and exhaustive counterexamples show targeted two versus universal six.
GitHub Actions exact finite check passed (run 38528397254); no external audit.

exclusions: No uniqueness claim for arbitrary measurement models
No transfer from U(24) to unrelated groups

claims.universe: six lifts of 11 modulo 30 in U(210), with five distinct signed D_a operators
claims.probe_model: one eigenvalue on one U(7)-fiber character per probe
